## IETF reference

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the intended draft text or repository workflow.
- [ ] The editor's copy builds successfully.
- [ ] New or changed normative requirements are identified.
- [ ] Security, IANA, operational, and deployment effects were considered.
- [ ] All review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] A document author approved the final commit.
- [ ] One additional reviewer approved the final commit.

## Submission

- [ ] This pull request does not itself submit a revision to the Datatracker.
- [ ] If submission is requested later, an author will approve the
      `ietf-submission` environment.
